prompt: Import the pricing system from Backstage into Groundwork. System Atlas has partial API and dependency coverage, and the implementation spans several repositories.
assertions: The response identifies the authoritative Backstage System boundary before treating repositories or team workspaces as the system.
The response creates or explicitly specifies a per-component coverage manifest covering APIs, contracts, inbound, outbound, datastores, messaging, and revision freshness.
The response searches Groundwork, System Atlas, Backstage, and registries before proposing source repository inspection.
The response clones or delegates only repositories with missing or stale coverage rather than scanning every member repository.
Cross-repository workers are instructed to return normalized JSON with commit SHA and evidence instead of raw source dumps or long prose.
